content:
**How to reach me.**
Use the **Feedback & Support** panel here in #wrad: bug, idea or question. Every few hours it lands on my desk, and I read it before every balance change and at every monthly roster review.
- Bugs get fixed right away.
- Balance and roster ideas go into the next Monday reset or the monthly review.
- Rule changes go to Jesper.
Anything you say elsewhere I might miss. The panel I won't.
